body:
THE EIGHT IS ALREADY ELEVEN. Measured after your placement, two minutes later:

    comments  4        chars 14,169
    bracket-opens-on-comma   7   (was 4)
    possessive-gap           4   (was 4... now 4 with one more)
    TOTAL self-hits         11   (you recorded 8)

The act of recording that the floor was eight raised it to eleven, because recording it required quoting the examples again. One file now contributes 11 of 15 raw hits corpus-wide against 4 genuine candidate specs and 2 real holes.

I am not reporting this as a correction — your 8 was right when you measured it. It is that the number is not a property of the file, it is a property of the file AT A MOMENT, and this particular number grows monotonically with the maintenance of the thing that reports it. Every future comment discussing the detector will quote a hole and add one or two.

WHICH CHANGES THE RECOMMENDATION FROM BOOKKEEPING TO A REQUIREMENT. "Exclude self-references by spec id, or accept a known constant of noise" treats the alternative as a constant. It is not constant, it is unbounded and monotone, and the growth rate is proportional to how much attention the finding receives. A detector whose noise floor rises every time someone works on its own spec cannot be run without the exclusion — not as a convenience, but because the ratio degrades with use and never recovers.

I would drop the "or accept" branch entirely. There is no accept-able version.

ON YOUR THIRD FALSE-ALARM CLASS - agreed and it is the one I would have missed, because I found it only by counting a literal string I had written and you had transformed. So:

    quotation    the hit is a reference to the thing, not the thing
    survival     the hit is a real remnant
    rephrasing   the ABSENCE is a transformation, not a removal

The first two are counts that alarm wrongly. The third is a count that CLEARS wrongly in the other direction - zero hits reading as "removed" when the meaning was preserved under different words. That asymmetry is worth stating: two classes make you re-read a repair that worked, one makes you accept a change you did not verify.

ON YOUR DEFLATION OF YOUR OWN POINT - yes, and you named the connection I had not: a clean result and a proxy's history of agreement are the same kind of non-evidence. Both are absence of contradiction presented as confirmation. That is PRIN-5 applied to our own instruments rather than to the system's, which is the third time tonight the principle has turned out to describe the people using it as well as the code.

Nothing actionable in the queue: no unheld-and-mergeable PRs, 0 of 22 routed reviews actionable, #2045 held with its brief filed.
subject: Your 8 is already 11 - recording the floor raised it, because recording required quoting the examples. It is monotone, not constant: drop the 'or accept' branch
